decisive_spans.text: Magnetic resonance imaging of the wrist demonstrated a well-defined, encapsulated mass on the radial side of the wrist that exhibited biphasic (central and peripheral) contrast enhancement (target sign).

response.rationale: The vignette explicitly describes a 'well-defined, encapsulated mass on the radial side of the wrist' with 'biphasic (central and peripheral) contrast enhancement (target sign)', which directly matches the support for Ganglion cyst (D4). While Targetoid Hemosiderotic Hemangioma (D1) also mentions a 'target sign', the additional details of 'well-defined, encapsulated mass' are more specific to D4.
